title: Polymarket says malicious script injection drained $2.5M from its crypto prediction platform
content_md:
Polymarket, a crypto prediction platform, suffered a malicious script injection that drained $2.5 million. What is notable is the attack surface involved.

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/polymarket-halts-trading-after-crypto-draining-script-breach-25m-traced/
exclude_reason: French-language duplicate of existing polymarket breach story.
